name: Vespid Dynamics Thermal Decoy Beacon TDB-3
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Thermal Decoy Beacon TDB-3
description: A small device that generates a thermal signature mimicking a human body, drawing the attention of thermal imaging systems and heat-seeking autonomous weapons away from real targets. The TDB-3 produces a 37°C heat pattern in a human-shaped profile using embedded heating elements, and can be placed on walls, floors, or furniture to create false targets. The beacon operates for 12 hours on a single charge and can be configured to simulate stationary, walking, or running thermal profiles.

specifications.effectiveness: Defeats standard thermal imaging and heat-seeking systems

story_hooks: A building assault team placed 20 TDB-3 beacons around the target structure — the defending thermal sensors showed 20 approaching hostiles when the actual team was 5 people entering from the one unmonitored approach.

TDB-3 beacons have been placed throughout a Tier 2 district to overwhelm corporate thermal surveillance with false human signatures — the system is drowning in phantom contacts and real threats are invisible.
